21cn.com.remark: Chinese portal and free email from 21CN/Tianyi.

24-mail.com.remark: Signup requires alternate email, CAPTCHA, and address fields.

astermail.org.remark: Encrypted email with optional recovery email. Password recovery requires a downloaded security code.

atomicmail.io.remark: Privacy-focused encrypted email service with free tier. Uses seed phrase for account recovery instead of personal data.

autistici.org.remark: Free activist mailbox provider; account requests are acceptance/affinity-based rather than automated open registration.

c2.hu.remark: signup only possible from hungary IP

dismail.de.remark: Registration requires invite link; email activation is manual/request-based.

emailn.de.remark: Signup requires alternate email for recovery; phone is optional; no CAPTCHA required.

firemail.de.remark: Signup form requires alternate email and CAPTCHA; mobile field appears optional.

interia.pl.remark: Poczta Interia domains. The wildcard *.hub.pl is documented by Interia but omitted here because it is not a concrete hostname.

jubii.dk.remark: Free Danish/international email service powered by MailCore. Now part of Inbox.com.

librem.one.remark: The free Basic tier is Chat & Social only. Librem Mail is part of the paid Complete bundle. The signup form asks for a Librem One address, which on the free tier is the Matrix/Mastodon username, not a mailbox.

mail.de.remark: mail.de FreeMail provider and related country domains.

mail.dk.remark: Free email service for YouSee customers.

mail.kz.remark: Mail.KZ mailbox domains shown in the current login/registration UI. Some domains are organization-specific, especially edu/gov/med.

mailfence.com.remark: Privacy-focused encrypted email service based in Belgium with OpenPGP support. Offers free tier with 500MB storage.

mailo.com.remark: French email service offering free and premium accounts. Signup requires recovery email, personal information (name, DOB), and CAPTCHA verification.

nate.com.remark: Nate Mail. empas.com is supported as a legacy login/email domain according to Nate Mail login help.

overmail.de.remark: Signup form shows free email registration and requires safe code/CAPTCHA; contact email/phone fields are not visibly marked required, but identity/address fields are requested.

pissmail.com.remark: Self-hosted email service operated by a single person. Offline as of 2024.

sanipass.com.remark: Formerly advertised free email at sanipass.com/host/index.html; the service is now defunct and the MX only points to a parking/default 123-reg server.

skiff.com.remark: Skiff Mail was sunset on 2024-08-09; automatic forwarding continued only until 2025-02-09.

skymail.de.remark: Signup page visibly offers skymail.de/skymail.at/skymail.eu; login page also lists maills.ch, maills.de, hemail.de, maills.net. Verify availability before merging.

systemli.org.remark: Requires invitation code; every account later receives invite codes.

tb9.de.remark: German b1gMail-style provider. Signup is not possible due to broken CAPTCHA.

tildamail.com.remark: Decentralized E2EE email with self-sovereign storage. Optional recovery email, no password.

virginmedia.com.remark: Free email for Virgin Media customers.

vivaldi.net.remark: Free email service for active Vivaldi Community members. Access granted through community reputation system (forum participation, social interactions, etc.) rather than traditional verification.

vodafonemail.de.remark: Signup can be done via email-only validation, but e-mail activation needs phone validation

yahoo.co.jp.remark: Yahoo Japan Mail. @ymail.ne.jp is a free Yahoo Mail address domain separate from @yahoo.co.jp.

z.org.remark: Short free email with aliases, XMPP, and static web hosting. Has TOR domain khav7sdajxu6om3arvglevskg2vwuy7luyjcwfwg6xnkd7qtskr2vhad.onion
